lines.text: What if *friction* disappeared... for five seconds?
Every step you take, every turn of a wheel, every knot you tie... it all runs on friction.
And the cars? The brakes do nothing.
Walking means pushing your foot backward against the ground. With no grip, your feet just slide apart.
But the people standing *perfectly still*? They're fine. No push, no slip.
And every knot on Earth would come undone. Knots only hold because of friction.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
